{{Quote|Where are we, Master Obi-Wan?"<br />"The former homeworld of the Shi'kar, obliterated by a comet impact some time past. Its remains have become a lawless region stalked by scavengers, smugglers, and pirates.|Ahsoka Tano and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="The Clone Wars 2">[[The Clone Wars 2|''The Clone Wars'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Shi'kar homeworld''' was inhabited by the [[Shi'kar]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was destroyed by a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and became an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] known as the [[Shi'kar Straits]].<ref name="The Clone Wars 2" /> It was located in the [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" />
